_finding: simulate_buy resolves a ticker against held records with their match quality (outside review of #266): a held record found by its bare ticker or ISIN must reach the verdict and get the 503 with its reason, not come back as not exact.

mutations.name: held matches lose their match quality
mutations.find: reason: lr.held.get(m.address).reason, match_quality: m.match_quality, normalized: Boolean(r.query_normalized) })
mutations.expect: FAIL simulate_buy: a held record reached by its bare ticker or its ISIN
